newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 28.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Tony Blair has pledged as part of his party's manifesto that there will be a position of an elected Mayor for London. Labour is also standing by its pledge to create an elected authority for the capital.
INSURERS HIT BY HUGE LOSSES ON AIR CRASHES

According to the annual report of the Institute of London Underwriters the insurance industry suffered a negative cash flow last year of 16 million stg last year. In particular British insurance companies trading in marine, aviation and energy have been badl hit.
TRANSCO BOOST KICKS OFF GAS CAMPAIGN

British gas pipeline division Transco is helping to finance a nationwide programme for gas competition in the domestic market. The scheme will be run by the Gas Consumers Council and will begin within weeks.
